summary: Ghost's three archived newsletters (Pet Shop Newsroom, Mailing List and Animal Therapy Waiting List) are no longer kept in the Newsroom and are left out of the Ghost members import.
detailed_changes: The archived Pet Shop Newsroom, Mailing List and Animal Therapy Waiting List newsletters have been deleted from /staff/newsletters. They had no subscribers, segments or campaigns in the Newsroom (#499).
The Ghost newsletter import now maps only the six active newsletters. Members who were only on an archived Ghost list get no Newsroom subscription (#499).
affected_areas: Internal impact: migration deletes the three unused archived newsletters; config/ghost_newsletters.php maps six newsletters
